title: Locking a mixed selection keeps it selected
reason: Reports tldraw locking all items in a mixed locked/unlocked selection while leaving now-locked items selected, unlike the all-unlocked path.
assessment: Varve exposes explicit bulk lock/unlock from the Layers panel rather than this Shift+L toggle contract. No matching mixed-selection lock action is established.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve exposes explicit bulk lock/unlock from the Layers panel rather than this Shift+L toggle contract. No matching mixed-selection lock action is established.

title: Tab and Ctrl/Cmd+arrow traversal visit locked shapes
reason: Reports Tab and Ctrl/Cmd+arrow traversal selecting locked tldraw shapes even though click and select-all skip them. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve Tab traversal builds its ordered candidates by walking all active-page roots without filtering effective ancestor locks, while canvas hit testing and delete actions treat locked nodes specially. Add a focused keyboard-navigation regression and decide consistent locked-node traversal semantics.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve Tab traversal builds its ordered candidates by walking all active-page roots without filtering effective ancestor locks, while canvas hit testing and delete actions treat locked nodes specially. Add a focused keyboard-navigation regression and decide consistent locked-node traversal semantics.

title: "Frame selection" shortcut does nothing on Windows and Linux
reason: Reports a documented tldraw Frame Selection accelerator defined only as Cmd+Alt+G and unavailable on Windows/Linux. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve’s shortcut definitions do not advertise or expose a matching Frame Selection command, so this platform-specific missing twin is not currently a local broken promise.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve’s shortcut definitions do not advertise or expose a matching Frame Selection command, so this platform-specific missing twin is not currently a local broken promise.

title: Context-menu paste lands under the pointer, not at the right-click point
reason: Reports Paste using the current pointer position after the user moved through a context menu instead of the original right-click location. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve anchors the canvas context menu at the original viewport point and captures invocation document/page/selection; its paste command uses the canvas cursor position retained from the right-click. The current pointer leaves the canvas while the menu is used, so no local mismatch was established by source review.

title: Pasted text and bookmarks are not selected
reason: Reports plain-text and bookmark paste paths not selecting their new shapes, unlike other paste types. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve’s clipboard import tests explicitly assert selection for pasted rich text and inserted nodes. URL/bookmark paste is not a distinct supported bookmark-node path in Varve, so the upstream omission does not match.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve’s clipboard import tests explicitly assert selection for pasted rich text and inserted nodes. URL/bookmark paste is not a distinct supported bookmark-node path in Varve, so the upstream omission does not match.

title: Handle drags ignore the Ctrl/Cmd grid override and apply the grid after shape snapping
reason: Reports line/arrow endpoint handle drags ignoring Ctrl/Cmd grid override and allowing grid snapping to displace an object snap. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve selection resize handles pass `bypassSnap` to TransformEngine, which suppresses the snap callback for Ctrl/Cmd; the dedicated line endpoint editor adjusts local points directly and has no competing grid/object snap sequence. The exact upstream ordering defect was not found.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve selection resize handles pass `bypassSnap` to TransformEngine, which suppresses the snap callback for Ctrl/Cmd; the dedicated line endpoint editor adjusts local points directly and has no competing grid/object snap sequence. The exact upstream ordering defect was not found.

title: Shift segment threshold in the draw and highlight tools scales with zoom
reason: Reports Shift segment switching using page-space distance, producing 32 CSS px at 800% zoom. The sole comment confirms fix #10240 changed it to screen-space distance.
assessment: Varve PencilTool does not switch between freehand and straight segments during a stroke; PenTool constraints use event-space deltas. The local project also explicitly requires hand-scale thresholds to remain in CSS pixels.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve PencilTool does not switch between freehand and straight segments during a stroke; PenTool constraints use event-space deltas. The local project also explicitly requires hand-scale thresholds to remain in CSS pixels.

title: Note tool doesn't snap a new note beside the note it just created
reason: Reports the note adjacency solver excluding a selected note left selected by tool lock, so a second note does not snap beside it. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve has no equivalent sticky-note adjacency slot solver or tool-lock continuation workflow.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no equivalent sticky-note adjacency slot solver or tool-lock continuation workflow.

title: Camera doesn't pan to the new note created with Tab or the clone handle
reason: Reports viewport framing the source note rather than the newly created note after Tab/clone-handle creation. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve has no adjacent-note Tab or clone-handle creation interaction, so this viewport-selection timing issue has no matching feature path.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no adjacent-note Tab or clone-handle creation interaction, so this viewport-selection timing issue has no matching feature path.

title: Escape during a scribble selection drops the prior selection
reason: Reports Escape during tldraw scribble selection clearing the prior selection unlike rectangle brush cancellation. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve defers marquee selection until pointer-up; SelectTool Escape calls `onDragCancel` and consumes the key while a marquee is active, leaving the committed selection untouched. Scribble selection has no separate state path.
